tables.name: TaiKhoanKhachHang
checks: EmailChuanHoa IS NOT NULL OR SoDienThoaiChuanHoa IS NOT NULL

tables.name: PhienDangNhap
checks: (MaKhachHang IS NOT NULL AND MaQuanLy IS NULL) OR (MaKhachHang IS NULL AND MaQuanLy IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: DiaChiKhachHang
checks: ViDo IS NULL OR ViDo BETWEEN -90 AND 90
KinhDo IS NULL OR KinhDo BETWEEN -180 AND 180
(ViDo IS NULL AND KinhDo IS NULL) OR (ViDo IS NOT NULL AND KinhDo IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: CaLamViec
checks: KetThucLuc IS NULL OR KetThucLuc >= BatDauLuc
TienMatDauCa >= 0 AND (TienMatDuKienCuoiCa IS NULL OR TienMatDuKienCuoiCa >= 0) AND (TienMatThucDem IS NULL OR TienMatThucDem >= 0)
(TrangThai IN ('OPEN','LOCKED') AND KetThucLuc IS NULL) OR (TrangThai IN ('CLOSED','HANDED_OVER') AND KetThucLuc IS NOT NULL)
TrangThai <> 'CLOSED' OR (TienMatDuKienCuoiCa IS NOT NULL AND TienMatThucDem IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: CongThuc
checks: (MaCauHinhMon IS NOT NULL AND MaMonThem IS NULL) OR (MaCauHinhMon IS NULL AND MaMonThem IS NOT NULL)
HieuLucDen IS NULL OR (HieuLucTu IS NOT NULL AND HieuLucDen > HieuLucTu)
TrangThai <> 'ACTIVE' OR (HieuLucTu IS NOT NULL AND MaQuanLyDuyet IS NOT NULL)
indexes: MaCauHinhMon IS NOT NULL AND TrangThai = 'ACTIVE'
MaMonThem IS NOT NULL AND TrangThai = 'ACTIVE'

tables.name: DonHang
checks: (KenhDatHang = 'WEB' AND MaKhachHang IS NOT NULL) OR (KenhDatHang = 'POS' AND MaCaLamViec IS NOT NULL)
(HinhThucNhanMon = 'DINE_IN' AND MaBan IS NOT NULL) OR (HinhThucNhanMon <> 'DINE_IN' AND MaBan IS NULL)
HinhThucNhanMon <> 'DELIVERY' OR (TenNguoiNhan IS NOT NULL AND DienThoaiNguoiNhan IS NOT NULL AND DiaChiGiaoDaChot IS NOT NULL)
PhiGiaoHangBanDau >= 0 AND PhiGiaoHangHienTai >= 0 AND PhiGiaoHangHienTai <= PhiGiaoHangBanDau
ViDo IS NULL OR ViDo BETWEEN -90 AND 90
KinhDo IS NULL OR KinhDo BETWEEN -180 AND 180

tables.name: ChiTietDonHang
checks: SoLuongDat > 0 AND SoLuongBatDauPha >= 0 AND SoLuongPhaXong >= 0 AND SoLuongDaHuy >= 0

tables.name: HuyMon
checks: (CASE WHEN MaKhachHangYeuCau IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN MaCaLamViec IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN MaQuanLyYeuCau IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

tables.name: ThanhToan
checks: PhuongThuc <> 'CASH' OR MaCaLamViec IS NOT NULL
TienKhachDua IS NULL OR TienKhachDua >= SoTienDaXacMinh

tables.name: GiaoDichNganHang
checks: MaThanhToan IS NULL OR MaLanChiHoan IS NULL

tables.name: HoSoHoanTien
checks: SoTienDuocDuyet IS NULL OR (SoTienDuocDuyet > 0 AND SoTienDuocDuyet <= SoTienYeuCau)
(CASE WHEN MaKhachHangYeuCau IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN MaCaYeuCau IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN MaQuanLyYeuCau IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

tables.name: LanChiHoanTien
checks: CoKetQuaLuc IS NULL OR CoKetQuaLuc >= BatDauLuc

tables.name: HoaDon
checks: (LoaiHoaDon = 'ORIGINAL' AND MaHoaDonGoc IS NULL AND SoTien >= 0) OR (LoaiHoaDon = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND MaHoaDonGoc IS NOT NULL AND MaHoaDonGoc <> MaHoaDon)
TrangThai <> 'ISSUED' OR PhatHanhLuc IS NOT NULL

tables.name: PhieuKho
checks: TrangThai <> 'POSTED' OR (GhiSoLuc IS NOT NULL AND MaQuanLyDuyet IS NOT NULL)
MaPhieuBiDao IS NULL OR MaPhieuBiDao <> MaPhieuKho

tables.name: TonKho
checks: TonThucTe >= 0 AND TongGiuCho >= 0 AND TongGiuCho <= TonThucTe

tables.name: BienDongKho
checks: (MaDongPhieuKho IS NOT NULL AND MaChiTietDonHang IS NULL) OR (MaDongPhieuKho IS NULL AND MaChiTietDonHang IS NOT NULL)
MaBienDongBiDao IS NULL OR MaBienDongBiDao <> MaBienDongKho

tables.name: NhatKyHeThong
checks: (LoaiTacNhan = 'CUSTOMER' AND MaKhachHang IS NOT NULL AND MaQuanLy IS NULL AND MaCaLamViec IS NULL) OR (LoaiTacNhan = 'ADMIN' AND MaQuanLy IS NOT NULL AND MaKhachHang IS NULL AND MaCaLamViec IS NULL) OR (LoaiTacNhan = 'STAFF' AND MaCaLamViec IS NOT NULL AND MaKhachHang IS NULL AND MaQuanLy IS NULL) OR (LoaiTacNhan = 'SYSTEM' AND MaKhachHang IS NULL AND MaQuanLy IS NULL AND MaCaLamViec IS NULL)
